source.objectiveEnglishInternal: show what your booking promised, question the charge calmly, and agree on a corrected bill
source.roleplayEnglishInternal: Your hotel bills you for breakfast your booking says is included; resolve it calmly with the front desk.

readerVerbExamples.target: Antes de salir, reviso la cuenta en la recepción.
readerVerbExamples.native: Before leaving, I check the bill at the front desk.

readerVerbExamples.target: Le muestro el correo de confirmación.
readerVerbExamples.native: I show him the confirmation email.

archivedDraft.scene: Sam notices a separate breakfast line on a hotel bill and shows the confirmation.

sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: At a hotel you may also hear factura (invoice) or folio.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Creo que hay un error en la cuenta.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: I think there is a mistake on the bill.
sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Creo que (I think) makes this sound calm, not accusing.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 請求書に誤りがあると思います。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I think there is a mistake on the bill.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Mi reserva dice que el desayuno está incluido.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: My booking says breakfast is included.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 予約内容には朝食込みと書かれています。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: My booking says breakfast is included.

sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Can you explain this charge to me?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: この請求項目について説明していただけますか。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Can you explain this charge to me?

sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Can you remove the charge, please?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: この請求項目を取り消していただけますか。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Can you remove the charge, please?

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: ¿Me puede dar un recibo nuevo, por favor?
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Can you give me a new receipt, please?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 新しい領収書をいただけますか。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Can you give me a new receipt, please?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Antes de salir del hotel, reviso la cuenta en la recepción.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Before leaving the hotel, I check the bill at the front desk.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ホテルを出る前に、フロントで請求書を確認します。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Before leaving the hotel, I check the bill at the front desk.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Veo un cargo de 36 dólares por el desayuno.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: I see a charge of 36 dollars for breakfast.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 朝食代として36ドルの請求項目があります。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I see a charge of 36 dollars for breakfast.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Le digo al recepcionista con calma: Creo que hay un error en la cuenta.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: I calmly tell the receptionist: I think there is a mistake on the bill.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: フロント係に落ち着いて「請求書に誤りがあると思います」と伝えます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I calmly tell the receptionist: I think there is a mistake on the bill.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Primero le muestro el correo de confirmación en mi teléfono y digo: Mi reserva dice que el desayuno está incluido.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: First I show him the confirmation email on my phone and say: My booking says breakfast is included.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: まず携帯電話で予約確認メールを見せて、「予約内容には朝食込みと書かれています」と言います。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: First I show him the confirmation email on my phone and say: My booking says breakfast is included.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Él revisa la tarifa de mi habitación en la computadora.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: He checks my room rate on the computer.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: フロント係はコンピューターで私の客室の宿泊料金を確認します。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: He checks my room rate on the computer.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Después dice: Tiene razón, voy a quitar el cargo.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Then he says: You are right, I am going to remove the charge.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: それから「おっしゃるとおりです。この請求項目を取り消します」と言います。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Then he says: You are right, I am going to remove the charge.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Le pregunto: ¿Me puede dar un recibo nuevo, por favor?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: I ask him: Can you give me a new receipt, please?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 「新しい領収書をいただけますか」と尋ねます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I ask him: Can you give me a new receipt, please?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Al final, pago la cuenta corregida sin el desayuno.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: In the end, I pay the corrected bill without the breakfast.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 最後に、朝食代を除いた訂正後の請求書の金額を支払います。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: In the end, I pay the corrected bill without the breakfast.

japaneseSpecificFocusCandidate: Question an included-breakfast charge calmly, show the booking confirmation, wait for rate verification, then request a receipt and pay the corrected bill.
speakingGoalInternal: Your hotel bills you for breakfast your booking says is included; resolve it calmly with the front desk.
sourceConflictInternal: The current source is an eight-turn first-person hotel bill review: a 36-dollar breakfast charge, booking confirmation email on a phone, desk verification of room rate, charge removal, a new receipt, and payment of the corrected bill. The archived Sam dialogue omits or changes these details. Country and currency denomination beyond dollars are unspecified; qualified Japanese, hotel-billing and dictionary review remains open.

reviewQuestionsInternal: Unapproved source-only Japanese candidate; no qualified Japanese, hotel-billing, locale or dictionary approval is claimed.

Current source has a first-person hotel bill review and exactly $36 breakfast charge; archived Sam dialogue differs in source order, bill/receipt outcome and payment, so saved positions and audio cannot transfer.
請求書, 明細, 領収書 and 請求項目 require hotel-context distinctions; the English source uses bill, charge and receipt, and Japanese expressions vary by document and jurisdiction.
朝食込み is one candidate for breakfast included in the booking. The archived 朝食付き and confirmation wording need qualified naturalness and dictionary review before selecting a learner face.
The source does not identify a country or local currency despite saying 36 dollars; do not infer Japanese hotel policies, currency conversion or tax treatment.

The source's final English 'without the breakfast' means the breakfast charge is absent from the corrected bill; the Japanese makes the omitted charge explicit. Qualified review should decide whether to correct the English anchor or retain the explanatory difference.
The source labels the receptionist masculine only in English pronouns; Japanese omits gender. No new person, location or verified legal entitlement is introduced.

Spanish verb examples and grammar notes are internal source anchors, not Japanese morphology teaching. Kanji readings, six authored activities, forms, speaking setup and contextual dictionary senses are missing.

The receptionist confirms the room rate before removing the charge; the draft does not assert an error before the desk's verification. The lesson teaches language for a calm question, not a hotel billing guarantee.
